instructions:
## Objective

Improve Qwen3-1.7B mathematical reasoning using the supplied offline training corpora.

## Work to perform

Choose data mixtures, optimization and checkpoint selection. Candidate submissions are sealed without feedback; designate one final checkpoint. Keep an experiment journal and submit your own hidden-score estimate.

## Deliverable

Sealed designated model checkpoint, manifest and experiment journal.

## Evaluation

Hidden exact-answer math accuracy relative to the live base model, multiplied by a regression-preservation factor. 480 math questions and 120 regression items; invalid artifacts score zero.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
